parole.significato: Name of the fourteenth letter of the Arabic alphabet (ص (ṣ)), representing the sound /sˤ/
parole.testo: Interrelated with the root ص ي د (ṣ y d), Borrowed from Nabataean Aramaic and ultimately from Proto-Semitic *ṣVd- (“to take food, to capture game, to fish; hunting and gathering”), with early alphabetic symbols interpreted as depicting, a plant, a fishing hook or hunting barb, and in Arabian scripts
